pages.title: Oscillator Vessel
pages.text: A stirred dish fed with bromate and malonic acid, whose colour swings back and forth on its own beat.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the bromate and malonic acid feeds A and B. It oscillates only past B = 1 + A², and its beat is about 2π/A seconds: the clock must beat every 3 to 8 seconds, at least 0.2 past the threshold.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Chemical Clock.
